statement: Drop rarity is a true multiplier to how often mobs drop loot and is one of the most important stats
Drop rarity stat is at the bottom of the character screen just above classic exp
With about 100x drop rarity Domo Magnus oval odds go from 1 in 3334 to about 1 in 32-33, not guaranteed
Wind walker gets bonuses to equipment and ring drops and medallion drops so more drop rarity makes progressing it easier
Godshard helmet chest pants boots and weapon are best in slot and each gives a misc drop chance bonus
Until godshard use divine equipment; its helmet and boots give a drop chance bonus as a temporary fix
Best pendant is still the divine scarf which has no drop chance
Chaotic Amarok pendant gives 5% misc drop chance if you want drop chance on every piece
Best rings are demented emperor opals which give no direct drop chance
Emperor opals give large luck and misc all stats; luck around 60000 gives about a 1x drop multiplier
Siege captain cap premium helmet gives 10% drop chance
Without the siege captain cap use the gold berry helmet for 10% drop chance; about the same
Divine trophy (one of the divine) gives 42 drop chance plus good stats and more total damage; recommended
Luckier lad trophy gives only about 0.35 more drop rate than divine and sacrifices a lot of damage so he prefers divine
Molten cloak is the only cloak that gives drop chance but better cloaks exist such as for AFK rate
Ballin name tag is best for drop chance at 40%
Aether Moon name tag is second best at 10% drop chance with many other benefits
An event name tag gives 3% drop chance as a third option if you lack the premium tags
Best keychains are any with drop chance; limited shop specials give at least 25% and are best in slot
Weaker drop chance keychains can be obtained from normal dungeon runs without premium currency
Equinox ring is best premium ring with 10% all stats and no other ring comes close; put it on whichever character you want
Evergreen robe gives 75% drop chance; without it use the cobalt robe for 60%; both premium
Godshard tools are best in slot and each gives 10% drop chance so making all six is a huge gain
Golden cake is the one food you really need as it gives a large drop rarity bonus
Also recommended is golden grilled cheese nomwich which gives a small luck increase
Apocalypse Wow on deathbringer gives account-wide golden food effect per mob killed a billion times so complete it soon for more golden cake drop rarity
Star talent Boss Battle Spillover gives account-wide drop rarity per weekly boss difficulty completed; about 60% for him with all five killed each week
Hungry for Gold warrior talent is another golden food increase for warrior-based classes
Archlord of the Pirates gives drop rate per power of 10 plunderous kills; 350000 kills gives a 24x multiplier on the whole account's drop rarity
Best way to grind plunderous kills is active farming oranges or citrines on the OJ Bay map in world 5 with the siege breaker
Optimized you get 18-20k plunderous kills per day; a million is worth it but takes 50-60 days
Most people should get at least 100000 plunderous kills then return later when new bonuses make it easier
Archer-class Robbing Hood talent gives 34% drop rarity at talent level 245
Voidwalker's Journeyman page talent Rares Everywhere gives a direct 24% additive drop rarity bonus for the voidwalker
Keep the Gimme talent active on voidwalker when crystal countdown farming; 68% chance to double loot for about 19-20 minutes
Upgrade vault Drops for Days gives a 75% additive drop rarity; costs many coins but grab it soon
Guild bonus Gold Charm gives 20% total drop rate for being in a decently leveled guild
Nocturne Gaming and two other guilds are recruiting; apply through the Discord
Put your best two drop cards in the top left and bottom right active card slots
Use the mimic card as a weaker filler if you lack the best drop cards
Passive drop cards are Domo Magmus 9% and fourth anniversary 12% and ancient golem 24%
Two card set options: bosses and nightmares set or event set; event gives slightly more drop rate when maxed
He uses bosses and nightmares set because it also gives damage and exp and few extra drop points aren't worth it
Island Explorer and Deathbringer bundles give account-wide multiplicative (not additive) drop rarity bonuses similar to Archlord
Golden six stamp gives 15% drop rate and can be multiplied by exalted stamp bonus
Golden apple stamp in misc tab multiplies golden food effect and doubled with exalted gives him 248 golden food increase
Buy the Five Aces in the Deck bribe for a 1.2x drop rate multiplier across the game; pick up all three drop items soon
Three star signs: Pirate Booty 5% drop and seraph tab 12% drop rarity and 20% golden food; worth getting all three
Star sign drop bonuses can be doubled with the world 4 chips
Companions: Crystal Custard gives 100% drop rate and Quincy gives 15%
Malle companion gives 1.3x multiplier to total drop rarity (100x becomes 130x) like Archlord
Complete more of the Owl clicker for an easy early drop rate multiplier; his is 46% and some players have 60%
Drop and Loads bubble gives about 38% drop rate; caps out early so 31-32% is easy
Orange bubble golden food bonus from Shimmeron gives 76% more golden food effect; grab soon
Trove sigil increases drop rate by up to 30%
Emoji veggie sigil gives 40% golden food bonus
Sailing bonuses can increase the value of sigils so they are not as small as they look
Dump post office boxes into non-predatory loot box for 33% more drop rarity and 93.8 luck and crystal mob spawn chance; worth it early
Ovals are one of the best drop rate sources as a base additive bonus multiplied by everything else; his gives 316%
Use the same ovals on personal and family tab; circle slots use silver pop ovals and never go above silver or they become golden squares
Squares and hexagon and sparkle slots use dice ovals
Roll a bronze pop oval to 3% then place it left and any other bronze 2% pop oval right; combined success chance about 25%
Successful combine gives a 4% pop oval instead of 3% saving many fragments; combine costs 3 fragments per try versus 1 per roll
Upgrade dice ovals by 1% each in upgrades tab; costs many fragments; targets 16% sparkle and 7% square and 11% hexagon
Farm pop ovals with elemental sorcerer on Gigafrogs in world 1 and reroll; need 12 for personal and about 12 for family
Hyper ovals save time and give a bit more drop chance if you get lucky
Get dice ovals with divine knight crystal farming on sandy pots or snelbies in world 2
Selling world 2 dice ovals is a great source of fragments for rerolling; silver gives 3 each while gold dice gives 9
Arcade shop sometimes has a drop rate bonus of 15% base or up to 30% doubled
Bonus ballot sometimes boosts drop rate so it may be worth waiting for it when farming ovals from Domo Magnus
Midasminded prayer gives 118% drop rate but multiplies mob health about 15x; good with enough damage and late game
Midasminded multiplies HP of all mobs including portal mobs so it hurts elemental sorcerer portal count; not recommended without huge damage
Midasminded can make farming nearly impossible on low damage builds like wind walker or deathbringer
Clover shrine from the construction workbench gives 87% drop rate by level and gets to mid 20s with world 4-6 bonuses
Equinox faux jewels at level 21 give 105% drop rate and could reach 180% at level 36 and may reach 200% with summoning bonuses
Slime and xylabone (world 3) and chalky (world 4) shiny pets each give 1% drop rate per shiny level; 42% total at level 14
Certified stamp book doubles misc tab stamp bonuses including golden apple stamp
Use doubler chips in lab console for the two card slots and keychain and trophy and star signs
Drop rate chip only works for early game players with drop rate below 5 and gives an extra 60%
Drop rate chip gives an extra 60% drop rate early in the game
Yumi peach ring multiplies all golden foods; with a level 14 stamp he has 2110% bonus to golden foods
Tome gives a significant drop rarity bonus (136% for him) based on tome score and requires buying the books from the world 5 shop
Finishing sneaking mastery one (floor 12) unlocks a free 30% drop rarity bonus
Chilled yarn at sovereign artifact multiplies sigil bonuses up to 4x making trove 120% drop and emoji veggie 160% golden food
Gloomy Ludy engineer schematic gives 5% drop rate per colony of glooies defeated; 12 colonies gives 60%
Sanctum of Loot gives 20% drop rate per ancient golem sanctum cleared; about 24-25 sanctums gives almost 500%
Measurer's 16th upgrade gives a drop rate multiplier that scales with golems killed in the sanctum; 82% for him
Wisdom monument gives a drop rate multiplier based on how many times you chose player drop rate in the daily miniGame; 45% for him
Four pristine charms: cloud 1.15x drop rate and 1.3x bigger summoning winner bonus and sword 50% golden foods and stamp doubler 20% on loaded six and golden apple stamps
Golden beanstalk lets you drop golden foods so their bonuses are active on all characters; his golden food bonus is almost 3000%
Golden beanstalk requires sacrificing golden foods (110000 cakes for him) giving 201% drop rarity and stacks with golden foods equipped in inventory
Well worth doing the golden beanstalk golden food sacrifice as soon as possible
Summoning winner bonuses include 260% drop rate and 30% all stats for luck and meal bonuses and equinox max level
More basic or endless summoning helps drop rate via many winner bonuses that multiply other bonuses

subsystem: land rank database seed of loot
statement: Land rank database seed of loot gives 232% drop rarity; leveling land ranks needs time with deathbringer
Crop scientist gives 213% drop rate based on crops unlocked; he has found 197 of about 230-240 so more to come
